fpsMeter.title: Frame rate
fpsMeter.legend: Measured with requestAnimationFrame, so it counts the frames the display actually presented — including the ones the renderer never got to start. Not the same number as Water perf's Frame, which is a median over sixty frames on purpose (the sweep needs a baseline a single long frame can't move) and so cannot show a stall at all. Bars are capped at {ceiling} ms; on a display that is keeping up, a full-height bar means the map missed, not that it was merely the slowest frame on screen.
